package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
class R2 extends BComponent {
  void a(long x) {
    long q = x;
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(q), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make((long) x), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(5), go, null);
  }
}
